decisions.reason: The Magento shop design template relies on design capabilities that are not part of the firm's core hosting and management tool knowledge.
The responsive website template is similarly a design product that does not build on the firm's existing technical and service expertise.
Premium customer support directly leverages the firm's established round-the-clock expert support and service operations.
The software version management tool aligns with the firm's existing software development and management tool capabilities.
The data processing contract tool builds on the firm's security and compliance knowledge and can be improved through legal cooperation.
